title: Signage & UI / Stage 5 graphic review
summary: Four sign proposals and a HUD and menu study set against current Unreal scenes. Review the cream and green public identity, yellow warnings, service wear and UI placement before production. [Review notes and atlas findings](SIGNAGE_UI_STAGE5_REVIEW.md) · [Editable source ZIP](sources/signage-ui-stage5.zip).

items.title: Four signage proposals
items.alt: Atrium plaque, yellow wet-floor warning, custodial notice and a cream poster with the approved wizard
items.body: Cream and dark green carry public information. Yellow and black identify the hazard. Rust ink is used for the poster. Each design uses an approved mascot path and editable English typography. [Graphic rules](SIGNAGE_UI_STAGE5_REVIEW.md) · [Editable sources](sources/signage-ui-stage5.zip).

items.title: Direction / Atrium
items.alt: Left arrow and Atrium plaque composed onto the wall beside the existing Unreal lobby doorway
items.body: Screen composite over the current Lobby entry. The arrow leads, followed by the destination and the pointing wizard. The proposed route and mount are for placement review. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-ui-stage5/atrium-direction.svg).

items.title: Hazard / Wet floor
items.alt: Yellow CAUTION WET FLOOR A-frame with slipping wizard in the Basement corridor
items.body: Screen composite over the current Basement corridor. The owner’s Stop prototype informs the stripes and header, and the approved slipping pose supplies the pictogram. Review near and at the corridor approach. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-ui-stage5/wet-floor.svg).

items.title: Staff instruction / Custodial notice
items.alt: Custodial notice with mopping wizard on the existing janitor stair wall
items.body: Screen composite over the janitor stair. Edge wear gives the panel a service-area finish. The sentence and mopping silhouette stay clear for close reading. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-ui-stage5/custodial-notice.svg) · [Wear comparison](media/signage-ui-stage5/service-wear.webp).

items.title: Corporate poster / A clean start
items.alt: Cream and rust corporate poster with the waving wizard in the current Unreal lobby
items.body: Screen composite over the reverse Lobby view. Warm ink, display serif type and the greeting pose distinguish the corporate poster from the directional signs. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-ui-stage5/clean-start-poster.svg).

items.title: Readability at projected sizes
items.alt: All four signs rendered at three labeled pixel widths down to 72 pixels
items.body: Open at 100% to compare arrow, warning and text readability by pixel width. The scene examples and samples establish a visual target for later Unreal distance and mip checks.

items.title: HUD / Health and hit feedback
items.alt: Proposed upper-left health readout below the native red damage vignette in the first-person Lobby view
items.body: The proposed card leaves both hands, the center and the captured hit vignette visible. The value is a mockup sample. [Full-health mockup](media/signage-ui-stage5/proposal-hud-1600.webp) · [Untouched Lobby capture](media/signage-ui-stage5/native-lobby-baseline.webp) · [Native hit feedback](media/signage-ui-stage5/native-damage-feedback.webp).

items.title: Main menu / Five current actions
items.alt: Main menu concept with a dark green title panel and five existing actions over the Unreal Lobby
items.body: The mockup pairs the title and greeting wizard with the existing action order. The background uses the gameplay camera with the pawn hidden for the capture. [Native main menu](media/signage-ui-stage5/native-main-menu.webp) · [Long labels and control states](media/signage-ui-stage5/menu-localization-stress.webp).
